title: Mattermost Desktop App versions <=6.3 6.0.3 6.3.2.0 fail to bound the Calls widget resize dimensions before applying…
description: Mattermost Desktop App versions up to 6.3, including 6.0.3 and 6.3.2.0, have a vulnerability where the Calls widget resize dimensions are not properly bounded before being applied. This flaw allows a configured Mattermost server to send a crafted resizeCallsWidget IPC message that can terminate the Desktop App process unexpectedly.
